tree.heading: Administrator
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency.

tree.heading: Advisory Board
tree.text: The term “Advisory Board” means the Land Between the Lakes Advisory Board established under section 460lll–22 of this title.

tree.heading: Chairman
tree.text: The term “Chairman” means the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Tennessee Valley Authority.

tree.heading: Eligible employee
tree.text: The term “eligible employee” means a person that was, on the date of transfer pursuant to section 460lll–41 of this title, a full-time or part-time annual employee of the Tennessee Valley Authority at the Recreation Area.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “environmental law” means all applicable Federal, State, and local laws (including regulations) and requirements related to protection of human health, natural and cultural resources, or the environment.
the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601 et seq.);
the Solid Waste Disposal Act (42 U.S.C. 6901 et seq.);
the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1251 et seq.);
the Clean Air Act (42 U.S.C. 7401 et seq.);
the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (7 U.S.C. 136 et seq.);
the Toxic Substances Control Act (15 U.S.C. 2601 et seq.);
the Safe Drinking Water Act (42 U.S.C. 300f et seq.);
the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.); and
the Endangered Species Act of 1973 (16 U.S.C. 1531 et seq.).

tree.heading: Forest highway
tree.text: The term “forest highway” has the meaning given the term in section 101(a) of title 23.1

tree.heading: Governmental unit
tree.text: The term “governmental unit” means an agency of the Federal Government or a State or local government, local governmental unit, public or municipal corporation, or unit of a State university system.

tree.heading: Hazardous substance
tree.text: The term “hazardous substance” has the meaning given the term in section 101 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601).

tree.heading: Person
tree.text: The term “person” has the meaning given the term in section 101 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601).

tree.heading: Pollutant or contaminant
tree.text: The term “pollutant or contaminant” has the meaning given the term in section 101 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601).

tree.heading: Qualified resident or relative
tree.text: The term “qualified resident or relative” means—

children.text: a former resident of the area within the Recreation Area or the spouse of a former resident of that area; or
a widow, widower, or lineal descendant of an individual buried in a cemetery located in the Recreation Area.

tree.heading: Recreation Area
tree.text: The term “Recreation Area” means the Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area.

tree.heading: Release
tree.text: The term “release” has the meaning given the term in section 101 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601).

tree.heading: Response action
tree.text: The term “response action” has the meaning given the term in section 101 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act of 1980 (42 U.S.C. 9601).

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

tree.heading: State
tree.text: The term “State” means the State of Kentucky and the State of Tennessee.
